items.title: Trump Says He’d Love to See a ‘United’ Ireland During Visit
items.content: <article>US President Donald Trump says he would like to see Ireland “unified,” a remark that puts him at odds with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham who recently said the issue is off the table. Olivia Fletcher reports. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Trump’s Convention Promises Face Tough Road Even If GOP Wins
items.author: Erik Wasson, Caitlin Reilly and Ari Natter
items.content: <article>President Donald Trump and top Republicans made several concrete policy promises during their Dallas midterm convention, but they all face massive headwinds in Congress even if the GOP retains control of both chambers.</article>

items.title: Trump Wades Into Debate Over Irish Unification
items.content: <article>President Donald Trump stirred debate during his visit to Dublin by saying he would like to see a united Ireland and that unification is eventually inevitable, departing from the caution US presidents have traditionally shown on the issue. Bloomberg News White House Reporter Jennifer Dlouhy tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the remarks drew support from Sinn Féin and criticism from unionists, while UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said there is currently no mandate for a referendum. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Farage’s Reform Raises Record £72 Million in Less Than 24 Hours
items.author: Jillian Deutsch and Alex Morales
items.content: <article>Nigel Farage’s Reform UK received a second multi-million pound donation, bringing the total raised over the past 24 hours to £72 million ($97 million) and far surpassing the amounts raised by the rival Labour and Conservative parties so far this year.</article>

items.title: BRICS Countries Call for Maximum Restraint in the Middle East
items.author: Sudhi Ranjan Sen
items.content: <article>BRICS nations including Iran and the United Arab Emirates have expressed “deep concern” over escalating tensions in the Middle East, using a joint statement published on Saturday to call for “maximum restraint” in the region.</article>

items.title: Iraq Fires Commander After Drone Attacks on Saudi Arabia’s East-West Pipeline
items.author: Khalid Al-Ansary and Devika Krishna Kumar
items.content: <article>Iraq is moving to contain the fallout from attacks that caused the closure of Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline, after the strikes were found to have been launched from inside the country.</article>

items.title: Trump Says He’d Love to See a ‘United’ Ireland During Visit
items.author: Olivia Fletcher and Jennifer A. Dlouhy
items.content: <article>US President Donald Trump said he would like to see Ireland “unified,” a remark that puts him at odds with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham who recently said the issue is off the table.</article>

items.title: Trump Says Iran-Backed Houthis Asked US Not to Target Them
items.author: Jennifer A. Dlouhy and Skylar Woodhouse
items.content: <article>President Donald Trump said Iran-backed Houthis have asked the US to abstain from targeting the militant group, as a worsening clash with Saudi Arabia inflames tensions in the Middle East.</article>

items.title: Trump Says He Could Settle UK-Argentina Dispute Over Falklands
items.author: Skylar Woodhouse
items.content: <article>US President Donald Trump said he could settle the dispute between Argentina and the UK over the Falkland Islands if asked and appeared to cast doubt on whether the British government would be able to deploy resources to protect the territory if needed.</article>

items.title: Trump Sees Canada Deal ‘Fairly Soon,’ Downplays Leaving USMCA
items.author: Skylar Woodhouse
items.content: <article>President Donald Trump expressed optimism about resolving a trade fight with Canada and downplayed the prospect of quitting a continental trade pact, in a potential sign of de-escalating tensions between the two countries.</article>

items.title: Trump Says US, Canada Will Probably Reach a Deal ‘Fairly Soon’
items.author: Sam Kim
items.content: <article>“You’ll probably see a deal with Canada fairly soon,” President Donald Trump says during a trip to Ireland.</article>

items.title: Germany Identifies Russian Agent Behind Drone Attack, WamS Says
items.author: Isolde MacDonogh
items.content: <article>German authorities have identified suspects behind a failed drone attack at an airport in Leipzig last month, including someone believed to be affiliated with Russian military intelligence, according to Welt am Sonntag.</article>

items.title: BRICS Nations Reach Consensus on Communique: India Official
items.author: Debjit Chakraborty
items.content: <article>BRICS nations gathered in New Delhi for a two-day summit have agreed a joint statement despite sharply divergent geopolitical positions, according to an Indian government official.</article>

items.title: Trump Jabs at Europe on Trade, Immigration During Ireland Visit
items.author: Skylar Woodhouse, Jennifer A. Dlouhy and Olivia Fletcher
items.content: <article>Irish leaders on Saturday welcomed US President Donald Trump on a two-day visit, seeking to downplay tensions that threatened to upend ties between close allies.</article>

items.title: Drug-Dealing Gangs Hold Key to Swedish Election in This Suburb
items.author: Charlie Duxbury
items.content: <article>Salim Ali watched for years as young gang members openly dealt drugs in the square in front of his flower stall in the Stockholm suburb of Hässelby Gård.</article>

items.title: Modi Forges BRICS Consensus in Shadow of Worsening Iran War
items.author: Sudhi Ranjan Sen and Dan Strumpf
items.content: <article>Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi pulled off an apparent diplomatic coup on Saturday, steering rival BRICS nations toward a strongly-worded joint statement despite opposing positions over the escalating war in the Middle East.</article>

items.title: Arctic Summit Draws European Leaders as Russia Threat Grows
items.author: Kirsi Heikel and Alberto Nardelli
items.content: Finland’s prime minister, who convened the meeting, wants to see more funds directed to the region where Russia’s threat is growing

items.title: Lagarde Joins France Election Debate at Normandy Rally, Feeding ECB Exit Talk
items.author: William Horobin
items.content: <article>Christine Lagarde entered France’s presidential-election fray at a political gathering on Saturday, as speculation builds that she’ll leave the European Central Bank early.</article>

items.title: Billionaire Delo Gives Record £36 Million to Farage’s Reform
items.author: Alex Morales and Jillian Deutsch
items.content: <article>BitMEX founder Ben Delo pledged £36 million ($48.7 million) to Nigel Farage’s Reform UK, a record donation designed to help the insurgent party fend off its critics while turbo-charging its attempts to gain power at the next general election.</article>

items.title: Merz Determined to Cling to Power and Defy Party Rebellion
items.author: Arne Delfs
items.content: <article>Chancellor Friedrich Merz is determined to hold on to power in Germany in defiance of the growing numbers within his party seeking to push him out of office, according to people familiar with his thinking.</article>
